blocks.text: Interior design project for a 140 m² private house in Dunajská Streda, Slovakia

parts.html: DUMSKAYA DESIGN (Bratislava, Slovakia) developed the interior design for a 140 m² private house in Dunajská Streda, Slovakia. The main objective was to create a contemporary, functional and visually cohesive living environment that reflects the architecture of the house and the everyday needs of its owners.

The layout and interior solutions were developed with particular attention to ergonomics, functional zoning and efficient use of space. All rooms are connected by a consistent design concept, creating a unified and harmonious interior throughout the house.

Particular attention was given to the combination of materials, textures, color palette, furniture and lighting. Each element was considered as part of the overall composition, maintaining a balance between aesthetics and everyday practicality.

The project includes the development of the interior concept and the design solutions required for subsequent implementation. Renovation works and furniture manufacturing were not carried out by DUMSKAYA DESIGN as part of this project.

This 140 m² private house project demonstrates DUMSKAYA DESIGN’s approach to contemporary residential interior design in Slovakia, with solutions tailored to the architecture, characteristics and requirements of each individual property.
